title: Wide-column stores

kcs.statement: A wide-column store such as Cassandra or Bigtable groups rows by a partition key and keeps each partition's rows sorted by a clustering key, so range reads within one partition are fast.
Wide-column stores suit very high write volumes with known query shapes, such as chat messages keyed by (conversation_id, timestamp), and need one table per query pattern.
